observed_v1_integrity_failure.reason: The official checksum-valid monthly Spot archive contains one incomplete 11:00 UTC row followed by five absent hourly rows. V1 correctly rejected it before any normalized corpus or strategy output was written.

revised_source_closure.proxy_rule: When and only when the checksum-valid Binance Spot monthly archive lacks a complete H1 bar, use the same-hour checksum-valid Binance USD-M BTCUSDT index-price open and close for portfolio valuation. Label every such row. Never interpolate, forward-fill, use a later spot value or alter perpetual execution, mark or funding data.
revised_source_closure.execution_guard: Every quarter-reset entry or exit reference and the final window liquidation hour must have a complete native Binance Spot bar. A proxy at any execution boundary rejects the corpus before economics.
revised_source_closure.path_risk_guard: Perpetual margin and liquidation continue to use every complete official mark-price hour, including proxy hours. The result must report proxy-hour count and identities; it cannot call the index proxy an observed Spot trade price.
revised_source_closure.failure_rule: Reject on more than 12 total or contiguous proxy hours, a missing index hour, a proxy at any strategy execution boundary, a second source anomaly class, or any non-identical hourly lattice outside the bounded Spot exception.

stop_conditions: Do not change any economic or performance rule from V1.
Stop before economics if the exact bounded Spot-gap exception does not produce one complete labelled 2020-2024 lattice.
Do not add another proxy, broaden the hour limit, interpolate, forward-fill or inspect strategy outcomes to repair a later failure.
After a valid V2 corpus is sealed, bind its exact raw ledger and normalized hashes in one preregistered manifest before running the economic ledger.
claim_boundary: V2 repairs only a pre-outcome publisher clock-integrity defect with a bounded official valuation proxy. It is not a strategy result, source-exhaustiveness claim, candidate, OOS value, deployability or Trading authority.
scope_note: No normalized corpus, return, PnL, candidate, OOS, paid API, key, second timer, second writer, canonical write, Production, Trading, database, order, fund, OCO, Grid, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE action occurred.
